content.short: Mode is an OP-Stack L2 network on Ethereum focusing on DeFAI and rewarding developers via revenue sharing.
content.description:
Mode is a high-performance Ethereum Layer 2 network built using the Optimism OP Stack, serving as a core member of the "Superchain" ecosystem. The network is specifically designed to foster ecosystem growth by rewarding both users and developers through innovative mechanisms like Contract Secured Revenue (CSR), which allows developers to earn a portion of the network's transaction fees. Recently, Mode has pivoted to become a premier destination for Decentralized AI Finance (DeFAI), supporting verifiable AI agents for on-chain trading.

Powered by the MODE token, the network provides a scalable and cost-effective environment for DeFi and AI-integrated applications. Mode inherits the robust security of the Ethereum mainnet while offering significantly higher throughput and lower transaction costs. Through its commitment to community-driven development and the integration of cutting-edge AI technologies, Mode is building the essential infrastructure for a more intelligent and meritocratic decentralized economy, where contributions are directly rewarded on-chain.
